name: Levier intérieur d'ouverture de porte 993, concept F0 aluminium
description: Independent concept of an integrated lever and clevis for studying a low-volume LPBF remanufacture. PorscheFanatics establishes the left and right PET part numbers; FVD publishes the envelope and mass of an aftermarket pair, but no interface geometry allows fitment.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM and mechanical screening of an opening lever; no fitment and no egress use authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - PET part numbers of the 993 interior door openers
sources.notes: The dataset at commit 4192f9699f1176bcfe8b8ec7cbcc7c05dc7ee296 identifies 993 555 851 00 and 993 555 852 00 as door opener at PET positions 807-10/807-11. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-DOOR-OPENER-PET. It provides no dimension.

sources.title: FVD - aluminum door opener set FVD55599301B
sources.notes: FVD declares 108 x 45 x 27 mm, 0.18 kg per pair, anodized or powder-coated high-strength aluminum and original fasteners. These values are a product envelope, not an OEM definition. See SRC-FVD-993-DOOR-HANDLE-DIMENSIONS.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg material data sheet
sources.notes: Ambient screening map only; the grade of the FVD product is unknown and no equivalence is claimed. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-MATERIAL-DATA.

material.grade: AlSi10Mg, screening; OEM material and grade of the commercial product unknown
material.standard: ASTM F3318-18 to be contracted if the concept progresses

post_processing: support removal while keeping access to the pockets
heat treatment qualified for the machine and orientation
boring and finishing of the pivot after the clearance is defined
machining of the mounting faces with a future machining allowance
anodizing or powder coating after dimensional inspection
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation and lot
witness coupon in the critical orientation of the lever
dimensional inspection of the envelope, pivot, mounting faces and stops
CT or radiography of the clevis and penetrant testing after machining
controlled roughness and radii in the grip areas
instrumented static and cyclic tests before any fitment

titanium.galvanic_isolation: To be studied between printed aluminum, pin, fasteners and OEM mechanism after identification of the real materials.

known_limits: Only the 108 x 45 x 27 mm envelope comes from the commercial product page; the plate, pockets, clevis and bores are F0 hypotheses.
The published mass of 0.18 kg concerns the complete commercial pair and does not validate the mass of the concept.
The 150 N and +60 K case is synthetic; no 993 load, direction, stop or temperature has been measured.
The nominal calculation ignores real contact, LPBF defects, pin clearance, preload, coating, corrosion and aging.
The CalculiX screen uses six synthetic cases and a Goodman comparison of coupons; it computes no part life.
The geometric slicing is neither an EOSPRINT job nor a melt-pool, distortion or recoater calculation.
The asset and the scene pass minimal USD validation and an ovphysx smoke test; the Content Agents, the full SimReady profile, OVRTX and the door assembly have not been run.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP within the envelope; it must be neither printed for fitment nor installed in a door.
